title: Wheel of Loot
description:
A broadcast prize wheel driven by a Foundry RollTable. The GM presents a wheel to the whole table and nominates who may spin it; every client watches the same wheel land on the same slice. The winner gets confetti and a keep / gift / refuse choice, and keeping it puts the item straight onto their sheet.

Comes with a wheel builder: browse every Item in your world and compendiums, drag them onto the wheel, set how many slots the wheel has, and re-roll any wedge you do not like. Works in any system; knows a little extra about dnd5e.
